findings.return: Normal browser-session read plus official OTT generation and one-time binding; two writes account for observed2 when ordinary signed-cache reads hit.
findings.exchange: Current application already atomically consumes and clears pending request with one locked CTE. Official OTT consume code has a transaction with latest-row SELECT, consume/delete and duplicate invalidation; session/user fresh lookup follows. Source 1+5+2 is consistent with observed8, not an independently recorded SQL list.
findings.decision: Do not remove replay, expiry, revocation, principal or callback binding checks to reduce counts.

findings.getOwner: Explicit disableCookieCache=true; returns fresh owner without a devices query.
findings.getFull: Same fresh session plus one owner-scoped, active local devices SELECT.
findings.post: Same-origin check, fresh session plus one INSERT minting an expiring user-bound enrollment.
findings.lifecycle: localSetupController checks owner at each automatic/manual admission. SshInstaller.waitOnline then verifies current owner and actual device ownership again. This protects A-B-A, sign-out/revocation and foreign daemons.
findings.notProven: 9 cannot identify exact GET-owner/GET-full/POST counts, retries or repeated mounts. Do not infer redundant calls from aggregate9.
findings.decision: No additional safe single-request redundant SQL found in these handlers. Do not remove the final fresh owner/device verification or cache it across requests.

findings.sourceBasis: findSession requests join:user; default core factory strips it before adapter and executes fallback user lookup. Kysely supports the actual SQL left join.
findings.semanticBoundary: Would still read current DB on every fresh request; no TTL/principal reuse introduced.
findings.remainingRisk: Global authentication configuration also changes Web and other joined auth flows. Relative Native-Web savings are not established and must be measured on both paths.
findings.parentDecision: Do not expand current24-delta work into global auth config; retained as deferred candidate only.
findings.scoreMeaning: One redundant DB round trip on each default joined fresh read; does not establish need to include broad auth change in this issue.
